title: I'm working on a 1-4 Player Co-op Game about time travel, I want play testers!
author: DevoutOG
selftext:
This is an Early Alpha  
[https://bad-games-made-fun.itch.io/grunt](https://bad-games-made-fun.itch.io/grunt)   
  
This game is a 2.5d first person RPG Sandbox game based on many games like eve online, Old School Runescape, Flyknight and many others. This game is fully vibe-coded and I'v been working on it for a few weeks. Currently multiplayer works on lan and through tunneling like Hamachi. There are 2 dungeons at the moment, each one being unique in some way, there are open world NPCs and Enemies and a few quests in the game. There is long term resource gathering skills akin to OSRS. and in the future will be expanded on much further. We have a massive and ever expanding POE styled passive skill tree and many ways to play the game. I am doing my best to update it as much as possible. 

This is 2 weeks of work so far. There are rough parts of the game still. Bugs and issues.

  
Currently I'm using the ChatGPT Pro 200$ USD Subscription and maxing my usage out each week working on this, I have another person helping me casually as well but most of the dev work client side is done by me. He handles the server sided stuff for the eventual connectivity of the game through lobby codes online.

I want you all to play and abuse tf out of mechanics. give me information on your version your playing on and any major issues you come across!
